scope: Animated pixel-art Maynard title with New adventure, Load game, Options and Quit
Five-entry pause root; Adventure, Options, Display, Atmosphere and Audio pages
Return-to-title confirmation with cancellation restoring the suspended interaction and map
Independent new-adventure save slots and title load browser; existing version-one save bytes unchanged

validation.after_full_run: Final focused run includes the restored location coordinates in the pause header and compiled earned-route harness menu updates. Separate earned route replays were not rerun.
validation.physical_gamepad: No physical controller connected; menu actions exercised by the automated input frames.

evidence.capture: Eight seconds of game-rendered title animation at 12 fps, followed by actual menu screenshots held for three seconds each; encoded at 24 fps.
evidence.fixture: Isolated game saves only. Gallery screenshots show default graphics preferences.

review.visual: Inspected title, pause, category, load and error screens, including 640x360, 1024x768 and 1920x1080 captures.
review.simplicity: Two focused TownGame partials reuse existing scenery, input, overlays, preferences and atomic storage. One enum replaces the graphics-page boolean; no generic menu framework, new asset or save-schema change.
review.packaging: Local build only; no package rebuild or new user-game launch.
